sources.beginner: hand-calc from prompt inputs as src/content/courses/corrosion/beginner/m06-one-screen-end-to-end/l04-the-capstone-brief.md directs (stream bookkeeping, Re definition, inhibitor arithmetic); panels ChemistryExplorer/RateExplorer/InhibitorIntegrityExplorer.jsx are SelectField-only sweeps on the shipped case (no capstone inputs) printing six(v)=toFixed(6) (ChemistryExplorer.jsx:35); probe shows no graded value leaked.
sources.intermediate: hand-calc inhibitor and allowance arithmetic from the surveyed rate, per src/content/courses/corrosion/intermediate/m06-which-film-governs/l04-the-capstone-brief.md; InhibitorIntegrityExplorer.jsx has only an availability sweep select on the shipped case, so it cannot be set to NEMBE CREEK.
sources.advanced: hand-calc closed-form inversions taught in src/content/courses/corrosion/advanced/m05-inversion-against-a-limit/l01-l03 (the brief src/content/courses/corrosion/advanced/m05-inversion-against-a-limit/l05-the-capstone-brief.md asks for bisection of engine calls, but no panel takes typed inputs; every inversion is linear so rearrangement equals the bisection turn).

fields.prompt_precision: The Reynolds number to four decimals. The partial pressures in bar and psia, the inhibition in percent and both ratios to six decimals.
fields.evidence: 137.42 x 0.0237 = 3.256854 exactly; taught in beginner m02 l01. tol 5e-7 is half a unit of the prompt's six decimals.

fields.prompt_precision: The Reynolds number to four decimals. The partial pressures in bar and psia, the inhibition in percent and both ratios to six decimals.
fields.evidence: 137.42 x 0.00093 x 14.503773800722 = 1.853591 (err 6e-9 at six decimals); the lesson prints the engine factor 14.503773800722, which the prompt names.
fields.notes: A learner who uses the studio divisor 14.5038 gets 1.8535943 and fails by 3.3e-6; the prompt and m01 l05 both steer to the engine factor, so this is a taught trap, not a defect.

fields.prompt_precision: The Reynolds number to four decimals. The partial pressures in bar and psia, the inhibition in percent and both ratios to six decimals.
fields.evidence: 0.00093/0.0237 = 0.0392405063; rounded to six decimals the error is 4.94e-7 against tol 5e-7.
fields.notes: Tol equals exactly half a unit of the stated precision, so a correct six-decimal rounding passes with 6e-9 of margin; any rounded intermediate would fail, but the ratio needs none.
